manifest.protocol: One fixed warm-home phrase-two state, four presentation conditions, two repeats each. Full descriptions and event content held constant. Conditions vary only option/candidate order and candidate identifiers. This small diagnostic cannot establish general order invariance or listening quality.

state.task: Choose one complete, procedural two-bar phrase by how well it expresses the scene. You select from valid candidates; you do not generate the notes. No audio is provided.
state.brief: A warm song for coming home

phrase.label: An answer
phrase.direction: Answer the opening with a contrasting shape.

history.label: Opening
history.direction: Establish the scene, with room to breathe.

state.candidateEncoding: Each candidate contains melody events. sharedAccompaniment supplies the identical remaining five tracks for every candidate; combine both event lists to recover the full candidate.

candidates.title: Lift
candidates.description: A measured climb. Short pickups lead to a held high note.

candidates.title: Settle
candidates.description: A descending answer. Settles step by step into its lower register.

candidates.title: Reach & return
candidates.description: Rises toward a peak, then returns with a longer final note.

candidates.title: Dip & rise
candidates.description: Dips into a valley, then lifts back into the upper register.

candidates.title: Leave a breath
candidates.description: Two small gestures with space between them and a rest at the end.

candidates.title: Find the offbeat
candidates.description: Offbeat attacks and short rests break up the pulse.

Consider the actual pitch, duration and rest events. Prefer explicit contour requests when present. These candidates have equal playback gain. Confidence is not listener preference.
